bibliography.title: Decentralized Attention Fails Centralized Signals: Rethinking Transformers for Medical Time Series

abstract_sentences.text: Accurate analysis of Medical time series (MedTS) data, such as Electroencephalography (EEG) and Electrocardiography (ECG), plays a pivotal role in healthcare applications, including the diagnosis of brain and heart diseases.

evidence.anchor: plays a pivotal role in healthcare applications

abstract_sentences.text: MedTS data typically exhibits two critical patterns: temporal dependencies within individual channels and channel dependencies across multiple channels.
While recent advances in deep learning have leveraged Transformer-based models to effectively capture temporal dependencies, they often struggle with modeling channel dependencies.

This limitation stems from a structural mismatch: MedTS signals are inherently centralized, whereas the Transformer’s attention is decentralized, making it less effective at capturing global synchronization and unified waveform patterns.
To address this mismatch, we propose CoTAR (Core Token Aggregation-Redistribution), a centralized MLP-based module tailored to replace the decentralized attention.

Instead of allowing all tokens to interact directly, as in attention, CoTAR introduces a global core token that acts as a proxy to facilitate the inter-token interaction, thereby enforcing a centralized aggregation and redistribution strategy.

evidence.anchor: global core token that acts as a proxy

abstract_sentences.text: This design not only better aligns with the centralized nature of MedTS signals but also reduces computational complexity from quadratic to linear.

evidence.anchor: reduces computational complexity from quadratic to linear

abstract_sentences.text: Experiments on five benchmarks validate the superiority of our method in both effectiveness and efficiency, achieving up to a 11.6% average-metric improvement on the APAVA dataset, with merely 33% memory usage and 20% inference time compared to the previous state-of-the-art.
Code and all training scripts are available in https://github.com/Levi-Ackman/TeCh

claim_closure.claim: MedTS 的 temporal/channel dependencies 需要分别建模并融合。
claim_closure.method_response: Eqs. (3)–(5) 建立 Temporal/Channel branches 与 logits fusion。
claim_closure.evidence_response: Tables 2–4、7 覆盖 EEG、ECG、HAR，并比较 Temporal/Channel/Both。
claim_closure.conclusion_response: Conclusion 重述 adaptive capture temporal、channel 或 both。

claim_closure.claim: 去中心化 attention 与中心化 MedTS 生理源存在结构错配。
claim_closure.method_response: Eq. (1) 与 Eq. (2) 对照 decentralized pairwise 与 core-token centralized interaction。
claim_closure.evidence_response: Figure 4(b)、Table 5 支持 noise/inter-token 对照；Table 11 仅提供信号中心化诊断。

evidence.anchor: EEG and ECG signals exhibit significantly higher centralization

claim_closure.claim: CoTAR 以 core token 完成中心聚合与再分配。
claim_closure.method_response: Eq. (2)、Figure 2 和 Algorithm 1 显示 MLP→softmax→weighted core→Repeat/Concat→MLP。
claim_closure.evidence_response: Table 5 在代表数据集上与 w/o/Attention 对照，Table 8 扩展到全部 7 个数据集。

claim_closure.claim: CoTAR 将 token interaction 从 quadratic 变为 linear。
claim_closure.method_response: 每个 token 只与一个 core token 交互；Eq. (2) 给出操作链。
claim_closure.evidence_response: Figure 2 标出 Quadratic/Linear，Figure 4(a) 展示 APAVA 资源差异。

evidence.anchor: only needs to interact with a single core token

claim_closure.claim: TeCh 可按数据选择 Temporal、Channel 或 Dual tokenization。
claim_closure.method_response: M/N 可调且为 0 时移除 branch；Eqs. (3)–(5) 定义三种组合。
claim_closure.evidence_response: Table 4/7 直接显示不同 tokenization 的异质性。

evidence.anchor: Full ablation result of the proposed Dual Tokenization strategy

claim_closure.claim: TeCh 在五个 MedTS 数据集上优于先前 SOTA。
claim_closure.method_response: CoTAR + Dual Tokenization 提供架构路径，但没有独立的 SOTA 定义。
claim_closure.evidence_response: Table 2 中 4/5 数据集六项全面优于 Medformer；ADFTD Avg 为 54.16 vs 54.63。
claim_closure.conclusion_response: Conclusion 使用 +4.11% 聚合增益。

claim_closure.claim: TeCh 更高效且资源消耗更低。
claim_closure.method_response: CoTAR 避免 Query-Key pairwise matrix；复杂度理由在 §4.1。
claim_closure.evidence_response: Figure 4(a) 仅在 APAVA、B=128 报告 33% memory 与 20% inference。

claim_closure.claim: TeCh/CoTAR 对 channel noise 更鲁棒。
claim_closure.method_response: 中心 core token 被解释为阻止 noisy channel 直接影响其他 token。
claim_closure.evidence_response: 单一 PTB 最后 channel 的 β=0–20 曲线支持方向性，但无误差带和多场景复验。
claim_closure.conclusion_response: 结论使用 stable 的概括，没有具体 noise 回收。

evidence.anchor: prevents the noisy channel from directly interfering with others

claim_closure.claim: TeCh 泛化到一般 multi-channel time series。
claim_closure.method_response: Dual branch 可同时表征 temporal/channel patterns。
claim_closure.evidence_response: 仅两个 HAR 数据集 Table 3；subject-CV 和其他扩展仍主要是 MedTS。
claim_closure.conclusion_response: §5.2 以 generalizes 更强措辞回收。

evidence.anchor: generalizes better to noisy, high-variation, multi-channel time series inputs

claim_closure.claim: core token 学到生理可解释的中心状态。
claim_closure.method_response: 结构上 core token 是输入条件的聚合 proxy。
claim_closure.evidence_response: Figure 5 只有 t-SNE 中心位置；无生理标签、probe、相关性或干预。
claim_closure.conclusion_response: §5.4 使用 “physiologically interpretable” 解释，但 Conclusion 未独立验证。

claim_closure.claim: MedTS 比 Energy/Climate 信号更中心化。
claim_closure.method_response: Eq. (6) 定义 SCI 与 DIC，但不改变训练模型。
claim_closure.evidence_response: Table 11 报告每个数据集一个 SCI/DIC 标量，无聚合方差和检验。
claim_closure.conclusion_response: 没有在 Conclusion 中正式回收。

measurement_disagreements.description: 正文混用 TeCh 与 Tech；不改变方法身份，但增加检索和复现成本。

final_judgment.single_storyline: MedTS 的跨 channel interaction 被建模为来自 brain/heart 中心源的协调；标准 attention 的去中心化 pairwise interaction 被认为会稀释统一模式，CoTAR 以输入条件 core token 聚合并再分配，TeCh 再以 Temporal/Channel/Dual tokenization 适配依赖。证据主链为 Figure 1/2、Eq. (2)–(5)、Table 4/5、Figure 4。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 Subject-Independent protocol、CoTAR 核心公式、双 tokenization 与分类融合、5 个 MedTS/2 个 HAR 主表、资源/噪声图和两组组件消融，因此模型决策与主要数值可读。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 附录承载增强、预处理、baseline/TeCh 超参数、伪代码、全数据集消融、Leddam/TimeXer、五折 CV、SCI/DIC 与 MedGNN。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 2 与 Eq. (2) 在同一抽象层级对齐结构直觉和可执行数据流；Table 4/5 直接做组件对照；Figure 4 将效率与噪声机制并置。
final_judgment.largest_gap: “best across all datasets” 被 ADFTD Avg（54.16 vs 54.63）和 MedGNN 对照削弱；显著性、资源协议、t-SNE 语义和中心性—性能因果均未闭合。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 领域归纳偏置若承担架构收益解释，应在主结果前预声明可测结构诊断与机制区分实验；t-SNE/类比图只能作为可视化，不应当作生理语义证明。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 适用于领域结构、结构—性能因果和跨域外推主张；纯工程效率主张可用直接资源测量和预设负载覆盖，不必引入 SCI/DIC。
